title: Teach a pilot cohort + capture pre/post outcomes
context: The project's 'delivered' criterion requires the curriculum to be taught to real learners with pre/post outcomes recorded. This is the first taught cohort: the moment the project moves from 'written' to 'delivered.' Pre/post assessment using the assessment-011 instrument enables normalized-gain measurement. Capturing >= 1 learner-produced verifiable reproducible artifact (public repo or DOI) is the primary evidence of behavioral impact. If a named partner taught the cohort, relevant tasks are updated to verifiedNeed: true. Depends on: pilot-006, assessment-011, outreach-007.
objective: Teach >= 1 cohort (workshop or embedded course) using the curriculum; administer pre/post assessment; record >= 1 learner-produced verifiable reproducible artifact; commit outcomes to the outcome ledger with externally verifiable references.
acceptanceCriteria: >= 1 cohort taught (workshop or embedded course) with at least the pilot module (pilot-006); pre/post assessment administered using the assessment-011 instrument at baseline and post.
Pre and post assessment results recorded in the outcome ledger (outcomes/<event-id>.json) with: cohort size, setting, date, pre scores, post scores, normalized-gain g per item and aggregate.

>= 1 learner-produced reproducible artifact verified and recorded: public repository or archived DOI whose container builds and analysis re-runs from the recorded inputs; self-reported artifacts do not count.
Outcome ledger entry committed with a verifiable external reference (public repo link, event record, or equivalent); DCO signed off.
If a teaching partner delivered the cohort, the partner's tasks are updated to verifiedNeed: true with requestor field set to the partner name/org.
If no external partner is available, a self-run workshop with >= 1 participant satisfies this criterion with the fallback clearly noted in the outcome record.
resources: PLAN.md (Success metrics — learners, competency gain, cohorts)
outreach-007 (partner/cohort outreach — confirmed partner or fallback)
output: Outcome ledger entry (outcomes/<event-id>.json) recording the taught cohort, pre/post assessment results, normalized-gain, and >= 1 verified learner-produced reproducible artifact; committed with DCO sign-off.
